LanguageData.CC_GodTamiu_WentAway_Text: The {CAT} that stayed beside {PAWN} all through the worst of it has got up, stretched and walked off. {PAWN} is still with us.
LanguageData.CC_GodTamiu_Saw_Threshold: {WHO} saw a cat come and stay beside {DYING} at {HOME} when {DYING} was near death.
LanguageData.CC_GodTamiu_Saw_Died: {WHO} saw the cat that lay by {DYING} at {HOME} stay with them to the end.
LanguageData.CC_GodTamiu_Saw_WentAway: {WHO} saw the cat that lay by {DYING} at {HOME} get up and walk away once they came through.
LanguageData.CC_GodTamiu_Lost_Text: A {CAT} sat crying by {DEAD}'s body out on the far ground until {PAWN} came, and stayed beside it after. {DEAD} can be brought home now.
LanguageData.CC_GodTamiu_Saw_Lost: {WHO} found {DEAD}'s body out on the land at {HOME}, where a cat sat crying beside it.
